issue_context.title: SenseME integration "listener task error" results in integration stopping
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The new SenseME integration doesn't stay up for more than a few hours at a time - I have received this error three or four times now (the first few on a patched version of 2022.2.0b3 adding support for fan lights, the most recent on 2022.2.0b4 with that support built in).

Reloading the integration from the UI resolves the problem temporarily.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.2.0b4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

SenseME

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://rc.home-assistant.io/integrations/senseme/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
N/A
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
2022-02-01 07:19:55 WARNING (MainThread) [aiosenseme.device] Master Bedroom Fan: Connection to address 192.168.17.90 lost
2022-02-01 07:19:55 ERROR (MainThread) [aiosenseme.device] Master Bedroom Fan: Listener task error
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/config/deps/lib/python3.9/site-packages/aiosenseme/device.py", line 917, in _listener
    self._execute_callbacks()  # tell callbacks we disconnected
  File "/config/deps/lib/python3.9/site-packages/aiosenseme/device.py", line 708, in _execute_callbacks
    callback()
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/senseme/entity.py", line 38, in _async_update_from_device
    self._async_update_attrs()
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/senseme/light.py", line 54, in _async_update_attrs
    self._attr_brightness = int(min(255, self._device.light_brightness * 16))
TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for *: 'NoneType' and 'int'

2022-02-01 07:19:55 ERROR (MainThread) [aiosenseme.device] Master Bedroom Fan: Listener task will now stop due to unexpected error
```


### Additional information

As always, I'm happy to provide additional info if it would help.

Can you provide debug logs for aiosenseme as well

It looks like the brightness is sometimes reported as none
Also does turning the light on and off trigger the issue or is it just random

I can't test this since I don't have a fan without a light but I'm pretty sure https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/65372 will fix it.

It would still be good to get answers to the above questions since I'm not 100% sure its right

It's just random.  I haven't turned on/off either the fan or the light at any of the times this error has appeared.  And I don't think there's anything odd going on with my network or wireless; all that seems sound and reliable.

I have set the logger integration as follows - is that what you need to debug the library?
```
logger:
  default: warn
  logs:
    homeassistant.components.senseme: info
    aiosenseme: info
```
It will likely be at least a few hours before anything happens.

```
logger:
  default: warn
  logs:
    homeassistant.components.senseme: debug
    aiosenseme: debug
```

It took a while, but it finally stopped.  Log excerpt attached.
[senseme-error-2022-02-02.log](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/7987098/senseme-error-2022-02-02.log)

Great. Thanks for the logs. It looks like they confirm I built the right fix so it should be good in todays release.

Let me know if there is still an issue
Awesome, thanks for your work on this.

review_comments: should a light without brightness have a color mode of brightness ?
It does support brightness. See comment above.
If device brightness is None, should `self._attr_brightness` be set to `None` ?
AFAICT It's just missing when the device reconnects and it will come in the next update. So we need to ignore None
